      public static String format(int value)
      format method: takes a integer value and formats it example use: String value = Money.format(1080) value is now a string that looks like $10.80 for negative values in billing, convert value to positive, then return with "-" before $ to show negative value
      Parameters:
      value - the amount in cents
      Returns:
      amount as a string e.g. "$10.80"

      public static int percentOf(int cents, int pct)
      percentOf method: returns an integer of the percent of an input value e.g. 10% of 100 cents = 10
      Parameters:
      cents - the input amount in cents
      pct - the percentage of cents to return
      Returns:
      amount obtained from percentage of cents
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - pct cannot be negative or more than 100%
      IllegalArgumentException - cents cannot be negative value
